canonical_project: Project Meridien / Gingerah Energy Hub AI data centre
owner: Gingerah Energy / Karajarri Traditional Lands Association / Fugro / Longreach Capital Investment
notes: WA Investments and ABC describe Project Meridien as a renewable-powered AI training data centre south of Broome on Karajarri country. Phase one is about 240 MW of IT processing capacity, with a potential path to 1 GW; feasibility is complete, FEED/environmental work is expected next, FID is targeted by 2029, and first-stage operations are targeted for 2032.
